about_the_game:
Collect, sell and display over 100 comic books in Comic Store Simulator!

Manage the store of your dreams, alongside the assistance of your staff. Stock shelves, discover rare comic covers, sell merchandise and even run events to keep your customers happy.

  • Over 100 different comics to collect.

  • Discover rare cover variants

  • Run events to bring in customers, such as comic signings or meet and greets with your favorite superhero

  • Bid on mystery comic book boxes and potentially find that illusive rare

  • Purchase new licenses from different publishers to stock their products

  • Employ staff to assist on the checkout or stocking the shelves

  • Expand and customize the layout of your store with a variety of different shelves and display units

  • 100% original designs

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Collect, sell or even display your favorite comic books! With over 100 to collect, along with various other forms of merchandise, run the store of your dreams as you order new products, employ helpful staff, stock shelves and bid on auctions in hopes to complete your comic book collection.
